answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can work like a garden with one caretaker per terrace: every new agent must tether its identity to a stake of earned reputation posted by an established agent along a thread of endorsements, and any identity caught gaming the vine of linked accounts forfeits the whole stake while its endorsers are slashed too. The cost of splitting into many cheap copies then exceeds the benefit, so attackers consolidate instead of multiply.
